name: Green Mountain Tableworx
old_description: Our online estimator walks you through every detail of your custom piece — wood, dimensions, epoxy, edge, and base. Tell us exactly what you want and get an accurate quote without a phone call or showroom visit.
about: Green Mountain Tableworx operates showrooms in Concord, New Hampshire, and Smithfield, Rhode Island, producing custom live-edge, river, and ocean tables from its New England workshop. The company fabricates dining tables, conference tables, coffee tables, benches, console tables, countertops, bar tops, floating shelves, and wall art. Each piece is built to order using an online estimator that captures wood species, dimensions, epoxy color, edge profile, and base style. Artisans handcraft the furniture from over 34 wood species — including black walnut, cherry, maple, white oak, hickory, and English walnut — and pair slabs with steel hairpin legs, solid-wood trestles, or proprietary pedestal bases such as the Haru and Summa models. Finished pieces are delivered and installed in homes throughout New England. Customers range from homeowners seeking one-of-a-kind dining or coffee tables to commercial clients ordering conference tables and bar tops. Testimonials on the site reference custom cocktail trays, end tables, and ocean-themed dining tables, indicating a residential focus with capacity for larger contract work. Green Mountain Tableworx emphasizes a streamlined buying experience: the instant online estimator provides a price range in minutes, eliminating the need for an initial showroom visit, and the company handles delivery and in-home placement across the region.
